# CLAUDE.md

## Testing policy

Use Vitest for JavaScript unit and component tests. Jest is not the project test runner.

---
paths:
  - "packages/**"
  - "apps/**"
---
JavaScript tests in these paths must run on Vitest.

---
description: Project test runner
globs: **/*.{test,spec}.{ts,tsx,js,jsx}
alwaysApply: false
---
This project requires Vitest. Do not introduce Jest as the test runner.
